title: Linear vs RBF SVM on the Pima Indians Diabetes Dataset
description: Train SVC with linear and RBF kernels on scaled Pima Indians data, then compare accuracy, precision, recall, F1, confusion matrices and classification reports.
aim: Compare linear and RBF Support Vector Machine classifiers on the Pima Indians diabetes dataset using standard classification metrics, confusion matrices and visualizations.
dataset: Pima Indians Diabetes dataset (pima-indians-diabetes.data.csv from the jbrownlee Datasets repository)

cells.source:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score,  accuracy_score ,confusion_matrix ,classification_report,precision_score , recall_score
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

print("Linear SVM Performance")
print("----------------------")

print("Accuracy :", accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_linear))
print("Precision:", precision_score(y_test, y_pred_linear))
print("Recall   :", recall_score(y_test, y_pred_linear))
print("F1-score :", f1_score(y_test, y_pred_linear))

print("\nRBF SVM Performance")
print("-------------------")

print("Accuracy :", accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_nonl))
print("Precision:", precision_score(y_test, y_pred_nonl))
print("Recall   :", recall_score(y_test, y_pred_nonl))
print("F1-score :", f1_score(y_test, y_pred_nonl))

results = pd.DataFrame({
    "Metric": ["Accuracy", "Precision", "Recall", "F1-score"],
    
    "Linear SVM": [
        accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_linear),
        precision_score(y_test, y_pred_linear),
        recall_score(y_test, y_pred_linear),
        f1_score(y_test, y_pred_linear)
    ],
    
    "RBF SVM": [
        accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_nonl),
        precision_score(y_test, y_pred_nonl),
        recall_score(y_test, y_pred_nonl),
        f1_score(y_test, y_pred_nonl)
    ]
})
